brief: A calendar showing energy levels — mornings are high ground, post-lunch dips are valleys

dominant_strengths: Clear three-bar AM/PM/EVE encoding makes daily energy rhythm legible at a glance across the month grid
Restrained dark palette lets the green→red energy scale carry semantic weight without competing chrome
Insights popover layers quantitative summary on top of the temporal canvas with consistent typographic hierarchy
dominant_weaknesses: Insights panel floats over Saturday column, occluding data and breaking the grid rather than docking cleanly
Bars are uniform length so 'Peak/High/Medium' read only as hue, taxing color-blind users and flattening signal
Weekday header row feels disconnected from cells; spacing between legend, nav, and grid is loose and unresolved
fix_priorities: Reposition Energy Insights as a sidebar or detail-on-select panel so it never occludes calendar cells
Encode energy magnitude via bar length or opacity in addition to hue for redundant, accessible signal
Tighten header rhythm: align month nav, legend, and weekday labels on a shared baseline grid
Add a subtle weekly trend sparkline or aggregate row to surface the 'morning peak / post-lunch valley' narrative
rationale.norman_balance: Competent visceral surface and solid behavioral legibility, but reflective payoff is muted because the rhythm story isn't summarized visually beyond a stats card.
rationale.intent_fit: It does encode peaks and valleys per day, but the calendar grid treats each day independently and never visualizes the 'high ground vs valley' rhythm as a continuous landscape.
